data.heading: What the room needs
data.text: Reinforcement in a theatre should support the performance, not compete with it. The system has to be even, intelligible and out of sight.

points.title: Even coverage
points.text: Every seat, from the front row to the top balcony.

points.title: Intelligibility
points.text: Clear speech for drama and musicals.

points.title: Discreet
points.text: Small cabinets, custom colours, hidden subwoofers.

points.title: Flexible
points.text: Presets for concerts, spoken word and touring productions.
